question: Can disagreement among several source-consistent causal hypotheses select informative actual interventions that measurably improve the same cumulative native tokenless learner's cold held composition, compared with equal-action random, fixed and full-posterior information-gain policies?
hypothesis: A small deterministic 24-member hypothesis committee, updated only by real revealed intervention consequences, will select 10 discriminating probes and improve native held composite Brier >=0.025 absolute versus both equal-action random and fixed-order probes on at least one independent pilot world, with no memory/retention regression. It may remain below the fully enumerated 2880-rule Bayesian intervention benchmark.

predecessor_evidence.classification: CKAD30 engineered PASS, scientific primary NO-GO: naive sparse readout raised Brier from 0.25 to 0.26736; cohort consumed, forbidden replay
CKAD31 engineered PASS, SCREEN_NO_GO: conservative GF2 guard gave zero confident mistakes but inadequate gain; pilot seeds consumed, primary unconsumed

inputs.name: new disjoint deterministic synthetic intervention worlds
inputs.sha256: Git source blob fixed before first non-B pilot and provenance locked in source_lock.json
inputs.source: Original test generator, SHA-256 seed namespace CKAD32. No previous CKAD29/30/31 held data or protected owner first-use.

frozen_design.mode: Research-only external counterfactual intervention experiment. No edits to native learner, owner, controllers or accepted main. Explicitly conventional grammar prior; a positive result would show bounded intervention-policy engineering, NOT independent native causal discovery.
frozen_design.world: For each seed nine independent binary causal primitives: four public context bits plus one action bit, each law intercept XOR five-bit parity XOR two distinct quadratic terms, uniform 2880-law grammar. Hidden law known only to environment reveal/scoring, not policy or learner.
frozen_design.split: Deterministically shuffle 32 context/action input pairs per seed. First 12 reserved as common held inputs for every policy, never queried or used for policy feedback; next six are shared initial disclosed intervention witnesses, remaining 14 are legal probe candidates. All arms receive same six initial public witnesses and exactly ten additional revealed actions, leaving four unused; zero held labels supplied.
frozen_design.candidate: For each of three old native slots, start with same source-only 2880-rule compatible hypothesis set; deterministically select up to 24 hash-ranked *distinct* surviving laws as bounded committee. Choose next public intervention maximizing disagreement q*(1-q) across committee with deterministic input-hash tie-break. Upon observing real source consequence, filter complete surviving grammar then resample committee from only the current consistent set. No hidden law ID supplied, no precomputed unqueried outcomes. The 2880-law grammar is conventional supplied prior, not novel native cognition.
frozen_design.full_exact_comparator: Fully enumerated posterior chooses its next intervention using maximal exact predictive entropy among all currently 2880-compatible grammar laws; same ten actions, same initial data/held worlds and cost-accounted conventional computation, never a native scientific baseline.
frozen_design.native_training: For each action-selection arm/seed: source-only observations from 6 initial +10 selected real interventions for each of three old slots, train existing NativeCumulativeLearner once per slot, invoke existing sparse repair only when native degree hypothesis is not eligible, preserve unmodified native and repaired readout. Add six separate pressure slots with 16 disclosed source rows each, cold restore, verify every old held forecast unchanged; scoped contradictory packet must quarantine one slot and preserve siblings.
frozen_design.budgets: Each arm/seed: 3 old slots x(6 common initial+10 selected)=48 source observations, plus six pressure slots x16=96, total 144 revealed source outcomes. 12 held common inputs x3 public composition graphs=36 held composite cases per arm. Each pilot seed uses four policy arms at this equal per-arm budget. No online use of held consequences.
controls: same untouched native cumulative learner and sparse fallback after each policy's own equal 16 interventions
24-member committee policy versus fully enumerated Bayes entropy, uniform random and fixed order; identical hidden worlds, held inputs and initial witnesses
exact Bayesian posterior prediction after each arm's chosen evidence (strong prespecified conventional readout comparison)
two conventional fitted readouts on each arm's selected 16 source records: polynomial logistic and observed frequency
uninformative probability 0.5 sham; deterministic negative controls for no held selection, no hidden-law policy access, no source replay, cold checkpoint and quarantined siblings
frozen_design.pilot_screen: Pilot 9451 and 9452, one first-use each; stop with SCREEN_NO_GO unless at least one seed has bounded committee's native *repaired* held composition Brier at least 0.025 lower than both equal-budget random and fixed AND its mean exact posterior compatibility count after probing is <= the random mean; both pilot cases must have full source/retention/restore/quarantine integrity. Do not substitute Bayes Brier for native improvement or tune committee size after seeing outcomes.
frozen_design.primary_gate: Only if pilot success independently sealed, before a separate primary first-use under predeclared source and thresholds. Primary 1451,1452,1453 unconsumed otherwise. Primary GO requires native repaired committee Brier <= both random/fixed by >=0.025 on mean and on >=2/3 seeds, and <= exact-IG arm native Brier +0.02, while strongest conventional comparator documented and memory zero regression. Scientifically supported claim still requires disjoint independent replication, matched resource budgets and mechanism attribution.
metrics: mean held primitive Brier and composition Brier, native raw and native sparse per policy
held coverage and incorrect committed primitive guesses
post-intervention posterior survivors and true law consistency for each primitive
per-step chosen query, public consequence, candidate posterior counts, committee size, exact information gain; no held leak
full Bayes, fitted logistic and smoothed frequency held-Brier on every arm's source witnesses
source actions count, cold checkpoint SHA, retention parity, quarantines, deterministic repeats, CPU/walltime and RSS if available
frozen_design.compute_budget: Exactly 2 independent non-B pilot seeds each with 4 arms and 3 primitive slots; 10 proposed intervention steps each. Each existing MILP repair preserves native 30-second/100000-node cap. No rerun of first-use, no paid API, self-hosted GPU or overlapping owner-loop execution.
frozen_design.environment: GitHub hosted Python 3.12 with pinned numpy==2.3.5 scipy==1.16.3 scikit-learn==1.8.0 joblib==1.5.2 threadpoolctl==3.6.0; Linux score only, independent Linux/Windows final evidence and full regression

classification_rules.supported: PILOT_GO if the frozen pilot_screen succeeds; development only. PRIMARY_DEVELOPMENT_GO only if primary_gate succeeds on all tests; never SCIENTIFIC_PASS from a 2880-law conventional grammar prior.
classification_rules.mixed: PILOT_MIXED if native and exact posterior gain is observed, but the preregistered joint native Brier gate fails; still stop and no primary. Primary DEVELOPMENT_MIXED only if a qualified primary run occurred and improved committee native Brier >=0.015 over both random and fixed but missed GO.
classification_rules.negative: SCREEN_NO_GO when both pilot seeds miss the exact joint improvement gate with intact source/cold/control checks; primary prohibited. PRIMARY_NO_GO when prequalified primary misses GO/MIXED. Retain all negative receipts.
classification_rules.invalid: INVALID for hidden-law or held-label policy/model access, source/test identity drift, unequal action budget, omission of exact Bayes/full IG/fixed/random controls, changed thresholds/seed splits, unqualified cross-OS custody, memory/quarantine failure or reused consumed datasets. Infrastructure issues are separate from science.

preregistration_note: Preregister before source/pilot; one source blob pin before action first-use; no primary until audit-qualified pilot; no automatic merge, promotion, integration or science claim.
